paper_title: Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for   Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation
caption: Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates execution accuracy results on the BIRD-dev dataset for two methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four difficulty-related categories. The horizontal axis contains the categorical groups labeled (from left to right) “Simple,” “Moderate,” “Challenging,” and “Total,” with each group showing a pair of bars. The vertical axis is labeled “Execution Accuracy” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at approximately 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60, spanning roughly from 20 up to the mid-60s. Each category contains two adjacent bars: NatSQL is shown in a light blue color and TA-SQL is shown in a darker blue color, as indicated by the legend centered above the plot. In “Simple,” the NatSQL bar is labeled 60.21 and the TA-SQL bar is labeled 63.14; in “Moderate,” NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; in “Challenging,” NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and in “Total,” NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are arranged as grouped (side-by-side) pairs rather than stacked, the categories appear in the stated left-to-right order (not visibly sorted by value), and values are annotated directly above each bar without additional visual emphasis such as outlines or shading beyond the two series colors.
